summary: Backend-only verification of GET /api/site/config fee_info contract consumed by the customer NATIVE (Expo) app's BrandContext + FeeInfoTip. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_site_config_fee_info.py (5 tests, all PASSED) against the local backend (http://localhost:8001). Response is 200 OK and contains top-level `fee_info` as an object with string keys `tax` and `platform_fee`. In this DB, admin-configured values flow through verbatim: fee_info.tax='GST @18% on platform commission & platform fee.' and fee_info.platform_fee='A small fee to run secure payments & support.' (sourced from settings.general.tax_info / settings.general.platform_fee_info — see site_controller.py L85-88). Regression: top-level `branding` (dict), `theme` (dict), `currency` ('INR'), plus `stats`, `cancellation_reasons`, `apps`, `business`, `seo`, `maintenance` all present and unchanged. No modifications to application code.

minor.issue: External preview URL https://api.webhubmaster.shop/api/site/config returns fee_info.tax='' and fee_info.platform_fee='' because its DB settings.general has no tax_info/platform_fee_info configured. Contract is correct (keys always emitted as strings); this is an admin data-config matter, not a code bug. If native UI needs non-empty text to visibly render the tooltip in that environment, admin must set the strings under General Settings → Fees & Taxes there.
Response is slow on first (uncached) call locally (~25s due to _home_stats aggregation). Cached (120s TTL) afterwards. Not a regression but worth noting.

action_items: If the external preview environment (api.webhubmaster.shop) is expected to show non-empty tooltip text in the native app, update its settings.general.tax_info and settings.general.platform_fee_info via Admin → General Settings → Fees & Taxes (local DB already has non-empty values and the pipeline is verified).
critical_code_review_comments: site_controller._public_site_config correctly coalesces None → '' for both fee_info keys (defensive).
Response is cached for 120s via cache_service — admin edits to tax_info/platform_fee_info may take up to 2 minutes to reflect in the native app; acceptable but document for admins.
